Enjoy Vietnamese food on the first day!
Jul 2026 • Family
The entrance has a Hoi An feel, the interior is very spacious and there are many carp swimming. I arrived in Da Nang in the evening and booked dinner here for the day.
It is about 10 minutes from the hotel by grab taxi.
From the first day, we were able to enjoy Vietnamese dishes such as banh seo and fresh spring rolls. Bainseo wraps the ingredients in rice paper and eats it with sauce, but the female staff is the first to set an example. Beer, mojito and other drinks are also available. It was a wonderful dinner.
